source: AS 1101.3-1987 Graphical symbols for general engineering, Part 3: welding and non-destructive examination. Read from Ross Edgar's copy on 13/11/2026. Clause numbers and short paraphrases only; no standard text held here.

items.says: The symbol scheme is consistent with third angle projection, which the preface says is the preferred method in AS 1100.101 (secondhand: 101 body not on file). It also suits first angle.
Basic weld symbols are drawn 'on' the reference line.
Elements of a welding symbol sit in fixed positions; specification and process references go in the tail.
Weld on the arrow side: symbol on the reader's side of the reference line. Other side: away from the reader. Both sides: both.
References go in the tail; the tail may be omitted if none. A general note ('unless otherwise designated, all welds to Specification No...') may replace per-symbol references.
Where a process is required it is shown by the letter designation in Appendix A (for example GMAW, GTAW, MMAW), not by trade names.
items.check: auto, advisory: flags MIG, TIG, MAG, SMAW, MMA and STICK in text

items.says: Site weld flag points away from the arrow.
Complete penetration from one side symbol is on the opposite side of the reference line to the weld symbol.
Welds are continuous unless indicated.
Finish symbols C, G, M, R, P give the method, not the degree of finish. Degree of finish is by AS 2536.
Fillet, bevel, J-butt, flare-bevel-butt and corner-flange symbols are drawn with the perpendicular leg to the left.
Arrow has a definite crank toward the member to be prepared.
Information on a welding symbol reads left to right along the reference line.
Letters CP in the tail mean complete penetration, whatever the joint preparation.
Multiple reference lines give a sequence of operations, first nearest the arrow.
Fillet weld dimensions go on the same side of the reference line as the weld symbol. A general note on fillet size can replace them on the symbols.
Fillet size to the left of the symbol, length to the right, pitch of intermittent welds to the right of the length.
Butt weld preparation dimensions on the same side as the weld symbol. A general note (for example 60 degree groove angle) can replace them.
Depth of preparation S and design throat thickness D go to the left of the symbol; D is always in brackets.
Root gap inside the weld symbol. Preparation angle outside it.
Surfacing symbol has no arrow side or other side meaning and is drawn beneath the reference line.

items.clause: AS 1101.3-1987 Sections 6 to 12, Appendices B and C
items.says: Flange, plug, slot, spot, seam, brazed joints and non-destructive examination symbols, and symbol design (Appendix B).
